description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Two sofas/armchairs grouped around a coffee table in the upper-left living zone, one facing toward the windows on the left exterior wall, the other facing inward toward the TV area. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: households needing ample storage (no wardrobe and very limited storage space); people working from home who require a dedicated desk or office area; roommates or families needing a second bedroom.
